// CASE swift_inorder_then_string expect=pass
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async rethrows {
  for item in items {
    try await step(item)  // await "x" it's
  }
}
let note = "we await (nothing) here"
// CASE swift_mwc_then_string expect=pass
func mapWithConcurrency(
  items: [Int], width: Int, operation: @escaping @Sendable (Int) async throws -> Void
) async throws {
  for offset in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: width) {
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items[offset..<min(offset + width, items.count)] {
        group.addTask { try await operation(item) }
      }
      try await group.waitForAll()
    }
  }
}
let other = "then await \(1) again"
// CASE swift_steps_then_string expect=pass
func inOrderSteps(_ steps: [() async throws -> Void], reason: String) async rethrows {
  for step in steps {
    try await step()
  }
}
